decisions.executionNote: Approach the black-and-gray doll with the left arm, gradually pitching the open gripper downward while keeping clearance.
Use smaller continuous increments after the rejected first target; move only the left arm toward a downward approach.
Continue the slow elbow-up approach and downward wrist rotation with the left gripper open; right arm stays parked.
Shift leftward to the doll center and advance while increasing the downward pitch, preserving table clearance.
Bring the left gripper above the doll with a near-vertical approach, using small continuous rotations and forward steps.
Finish aligning the downward-facing open gripper over the doll, with small lateral correction toward its center.
Lower the open left gripper cautiously around the doll's torso while completing the vertical alignment.
Lower a final small amount and close the left gripper around the doll; verify actual retention visually before a full lift.
Maintain the closed command to settle the grasp, then perform a small vertical test lift while checking whether the doll follows.
The doll appears retained between the fingers during the test lift. Raise it vertically with the left gripper held closed.
Continue the vertical lift beyond 10 cm with a clearance margin; the doll remains visibly held, and the gripper stays closed.
